done_when: A review no longer finds: Not done: older merged parts lose their shared runway
why: Review finding left open by FORGE-BOARD-2/COUNTS: Not done: older merged parts lose their shared runway (src/forge/board_facts.py:75): Raise: Not done. The cached searches cover only the current week and six full weeks. For a story still in progress with a part merged eight weeks ago, a teammate without local timing logs cannot get that part's PR body. `board.py:577–580` then builds its runway without the published intervals, so the story's working and waiting time differs between machines.
